description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ThingsMetadataSource' that provides a stream of metadata from the 'things' service, including methods for creating and requesting streams, processing stream data, and converting streamed snapshots into metadata objects.

classes.name: ThingsMetadataSource
classes.description: A utility class for streaming metadata related to 'things' from an external source, providing methods to create, request, process, and convert streaming data into metadata objects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method for creating an instance of ThingsMetadataSource with specified pubSubMediator, burst size, and idle timeout.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates a stream of Metadata objects starting from a specified lower bound ThingId, streaming data received from the 'things' service.

methods.name: getStartStreamCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command object to initiate streaming of 'things' metadata, optionally from a lower bound.

methods.name: requestStream
methods.description: Requests a stream of SourceRef objects from the pubSubMediator actor, handling responses to produce a source reference or fail.

methods.name: getStreamedSnapshots
methods.description: Extracts a stream of StreamedSnapshot objects from a SourceRef.

methods.name: toMetadata
methods.description: Converts a StreamedSnapshot object into an Optional Metadata object, extracting relevant fields like policyId, thingId, revision, and modified timestamp.
